pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Configure a Git to commit & tag back to the remote
steps.run:
git config user.name "${GITHUB_ACTOR}"
git config user.email "${GITHUB_ACTOR}@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Release for `@saleor/cli`
steps.run: pnpm release ${{ inputs.version }} --ci ${{ startsWith(inputs.version, 'pre') && '--preRelease=rc --npm.tag=next' || '' }} --dry-run ${{ secrets.DRY_RUN || true }}
